info.title: DPOLens
info.summary: Policies and law, with citations a client can check
info.description:
The only way into DPOLens. Every surface, including the MCP server and the
dashboard, is a client of this API.

Interfaces change without notice until 1.0. Errors are
[RFC 9457](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9457/) problem details, and `type`
is the field to branch on.

post.summary: Choose a password with a sign-in link, and sign in
post.description:
The link is the credential, so nothing else is asked for, and it is spent here.

No throttle: the link's secret is 256 random bits, which nobody guesses.

put.description:
Every other session of the person's ends; this one stays.

A wrong current password counts against the same throttle as a wrong password
at sign-in, so this form cannot be used to guess it faster.

Catalog.title: Catalog
Catalog.description: Every permission this build defines. Roles are made from these and nothing else.

key.title: Key
key.description: The canonical key a citation points at

label.title: Label
label.description: The numbering the law itself uses, such as 1. or (a)

text.title: Text
text.description: The clause as it stands, verbatim

is_authoritative.title: Is Authoritative
is_authoritative.description: Whether this language is the one that prevails in law

authoritative_language.title: Authoritative Language
authoritative_language.description: For a law, the language whose text prevails where its texts disagree. Null for an organisation's own policy

authoritative_text.title: Authoritative Text
authoritative_text.description: For a clause shown in translation, the text that prevails, verbatim. Null when the clause is shown in the language that prevails

is_normative.title: Is Normative
is_normative.description: False for text that explains without obliging, such as a recital

pack_slug.title: Pack Slug
pack_slug.description: Null for an organisation's own policy

trust_tier.title: Trust Tier
trust_tier.description: verified when a named maintainer checked the pack against the official source, community when it has passed validation only, null for a policy

pack_slug.title: Pack Slug
pack_slug.description: The law's pack, or null for a policy

trail.title: Trail
trail.description: Label and heading, outermost first, down to it

ClauseName.title: ClauseName
ClauseName.description: A clause as a citation names it, in the language it was returned in.

text.title: Text
text.description: The words in the clause that pointed at it

authoritative_language.title: Authoritative Language
authoritative_language.description: For a law, the language whose text prevails where its texts disagree

in_selected_laws.title: In Selected Laws
in_selected_laws.description: False for a law the organisation has not selected. Always true for the organisation's own policies

outline.title: Outline
outline.description: The top level only, without text. Read further with a clause key

total.title: Total
total.description: How many documents are in force, ignoring limit and offset

next.title: Next
next.description: Send as `before` for the next page

details.title: Details
details.description: As stored, the before and after of the change

actor.description: Who acted. Null for the command line or the instance

mcp_url.title: Mcp Url
mcp_url.description: The MCP server's address, for an assistant's configuration

Introspection.title: Introspection
Introspection.description:
Who a token belongs to, and what it may do right now.

`active` is false for anything that cannot be used, whether it is unknown,
revoked, expired or owned by somebody who has left. A surface only needs to
know that it cannot act; the API decides what it may do on the call itself.

token.title: Token
token.description: The token presented by the caller being asked about

LinkDetails.title: LinkDetails
LinkDetails.description: Who a sign-in link is for, so the page can greet them before they choose a password.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Left out, it does not expire

children.title: Children
children.description: How many clauses sit directly beneath this one

OutlineEntry.title: OutlineEntry
OutlineEntry.description:
What a top-level clause is, without what it says.

The text is absent on purpose: an outline that carried it would return whole
documents for anything whose top level holds real text, such as recitals.
Read the words with the clause routes.

previous_questions.title: Previous Questions
previous_questions.description: In the same number of days just before

most_cited.title: Most Cited
most_cited.description: First result of a search, or read by key

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Where the first result of an answered search came from

unanswered.title: Unanswered
unanswered.description: The latest searches that found nothing

has_password.title: Has Password
has_password.description: Whether they can sign in with a password today

sign_in_link_expires_at.title: Sign In Link Expires At
sign_in_link_expires_at.description: When their unused sign-in link runs out, if they have one

working_tokens.title: Working Tokens
working_tokens.description: Tokens not revoked and not expired

acts_for_others.title: Acts For Others
acts_for_others.description: Holds a token trusted to act for others, as the MCP server's account does

Person.title: Person
Person.description: Someone who can sign in, or a service account that holds tokens.

type.title: Type
type.description: Stable identifier for this kind of failure

ProblemDocument.title: ProblemDocument
ProblemDocument.description:
The error shape, declared so the specification carries it.

A client branches on `type`. `title` and `status` say what class of failure it
is, and `detail` is written for whoever has to fix it. Some problems add a
field of their own, such as the permission a token is missing.

question.title: Question
question.description: As stored: personal data replaced by placeholders

target.title: Target
target.description: The key or slug read, for a read rather than a search

asker.description: Only when names were asked for, and allowed

total.title: Total
total.description: How many the filter selects in all

next.title: Next
next.description: Send as `before` for the next page

identities.title: Identities
identities.description: Whether names are in this answer

breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.description: Where the clause sits, outermost first

expanded.title: Expanded
expanded.description: Siblings or the parent, when the request asked

ranks.title: Ranks
ranks.description: Where each retriever placed this clause, when the request asked to explain. A debugging aid whose meaning changes when the fusion rule does

in_selected_laws.title: In Selected Laws
in_selected_laws.description: False for a clause from a law the organisation has not selected, which a search reaches only when its laws name it. Always true for the organisation's own policies

laws.title: Laws
laws.description: The laws this search covered, by slug, besides the organisation's policies

RoleChange.title: RoleChange
RoleChange.description: Any of the three. Permissions, when sent, are the whole new set.

is_seeded.title: Is Seeded
is_seeded.description: Created with the instance. It is an ordinary role

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Goes up with every change. Send it back in `If-Match`

updated_by.title: Updated By
updated_by.description: Who changed it last, or null for a change made on the command line

lang.title: Lang
lang.description: The language of the question, en or ar. Left out, it is read from the letters the question is written in. Each clause comes back in it where the clause has text in it, and otherwise in the language that prevails

laws.title: Laws
laws.description: The laws to search, by slug, such as gdpr or uae-pdpl. Left out, the organisation's selected laws, or every loaded law until it has chosen. A law outside the selection comes back with in_selected_laws false

expand.title: Expand
expand.description: Also return the siblings, or the parent, of each hit

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Read the corpus as it stood on this date, to cite what was in force then

include_explanatory.title: Include Explanatory
include_explanatory.description: Include text that explains without obliging, such as a recital. Off by default, because such text reads more like a question than the article that creates the duty

explain.title: Explain
explain.description: Include each retriever's ranking, for debugging

SignInLinkMade.title: SignInLinkMade
SignInLinkMade.description: A link's secret, shown once. The dashboard's page for it is `/welcome#<secret>`.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: What this session may do right now

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: When the session ends however much it is used

idle_minutes.title: Idle Minutes
idle_minutes.description: Minutes without a request after which it ends sooner

SignedIn.title: SignedIn
SignedIn.description: Who is signed in, what they may do, and when the session ends.

pack_slug.title: Pack Slug
pack_slug.description: The law's pack, or null for the organisation's policies
